items.title: OpenAI agents claim Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize solution
items.body: OpenAI agents using a next-generation internal model produced a claimed analytical proof and Lean formalization of a Navier–Stokes singularity. The result used ~10k coordinating agents over 88 hours and immediately drew priority and data-contamination questions from mathematicians who had been iterating on related work with OpenAI tools while affiliated with Anthropic. Watch next for independent verification of the Lean proofs.

items.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 and GPT-Image-2.5 Flare/Sunburst launch
items.body: ChatGPT Images 2.5 launched 8 Sep with up to 50 % lower latency, sharper detail, multi-turn editing fidelity, and new Sketch/templates. API variants GPT-Image-2.5 Flare (default, faster) and Sunburst (higher precision) available; Arena rankings place Sunburst #1 across text-to-image and edit arenas.

items.title: OpenAI on the Navier–Stokes claim
items.body: We’re sharing a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem… The proof was produced by a group of agents, using an OpenAI next-generation model significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra.

items.title: 美控DeepSeek等陆6大AI开发商「恶意蒸馏」窃关键技术
items.body: US NSA/FBI/CISA joint advisory of 8 Sep accuses DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI of industrial-scale distillation of Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and xAI models since 2024, likely with Chinese government awareness.
